description: Binnenschifffahrt in den Bremischen Häfen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Transparenzportal Bremen. The portal shows 2025-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
